messages.author: ce4d07dca278fde0
messages.subject: Academic pricing
parts:
Thanks for the recent information about moving to beta. We have been very happy with shinyapps so far. My question is about the pricing scheme - do you anticipate introducing an academic discount for research users? (e.g. we use our app to calculate reaction mixes in the lab).

Best regards,
Lukas

messages.author: 07947d2dbeca2a40
messages.subject: Re: Academic pricing
parts:
Hi Lukas,
I'm glad to hear you're happy with shinyapps.io so far.

Our pricing plans are all here (scroll down a bit): http://www.rstudio.com/products/shinyapps/

The Free plan is intended (but not limited) for students and researchers who do not need the additional features of our paid plans; and the paid plans are all less expensive than Shiny Server Pro even at the 50% discounted price for academic research. Does that seem reasonable?

An important planning assumption for shinyapps.io is that we can price it below Shiny Server Pro even though we're hosting the computing infrastructure because it requires no / very little cost of sales. All purchases are by credit card and all plans apply to everybody so we don't have to qualify anyone for special pricing. Does that make sense? 

Thanks for the feedback.

Roger

messages.author: ce4d07dca278fde0
messages.subject: Re: Academic pricing
parts:
Hi Roger,

Thanks for the information. I should have mentioned that I was asking mainly because of the 50 active hours limit on free accounts, not the additional features.

We had a few users accessing our app in the lab, and I noticed we were getting close to 50 hours per month - so we were thinking about how to manage this, or possibly move to a higher tier plan at the end of the beta period (depending on funding etc). I could also imagine that 50 hours could be too little in some teaching settings, for example if a large group of students were asked to access a shinyapps.io app for an exercise in a university tutorial or assignment.

I understand the point about minimizing cost of sales and admin.

Thanks for the response and best regards,
Lukas

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Academic pricing
parts:
Hi Lukas,
Just to be clear on the 50 hours, the hours are measured by the time the applications are up, not by the number of students accessing it.  Ie. a Single application could potentially service 100s of students in an hour depending on the complexity of the application of course.

Not sure if that was clear in our explanation of active hours.

-Tareef
